info.title: Web Respect consent receipt contract
info.description: Host-owned server-to-server API. UUIDs are correlation handles, not verified identity. Updates and withdrawals append records.

201.description: Receipt with id, server receivedAt and submitted record

422.description: Invalid schema, policy, time or choices

get.summary: Latest choices and validity for host-authorized subject

200.description: Receipt and valid boolean (policy and expiry)

delete.summary: Privileged privacy-request deletion for authorized subject

gatewayToken.description: Host gateway credential; never delivered to the browser

Subject.name: X-WR-Subject
Subject.description: Derived and authorized by the host, never trusted from browser input
